name: system-design-notes
description: Notes of the book System Desgin Interview - An Insider's Guide
one_liner: A free set of study notes summarizing a popular system-design interview prep book.
buyer: None specific — this is a personal study-notes repo, not a product; the closest 'buyer' would be a job-seeking engineer who just wants free interview prep and won't pay for this in its current form.
business_use_cases: A bootcamp could reference it as free supplementary reading linked from their paid interview-prep course.
A content creator could turn the notes into a paid flashcard app or spaced-repetition deck for system-design interviews.
A recruiter or hiring platform could link to it as a free resource to attract candidates to their job board.

money_ideas.idea: Turn the notes into a paid mock-interview or flashcard app with spaced repetition.

steal_this: Honestly, not much here worth stealing directly — it's condensed notes of someone else's book. The real opportunity is building a study tool around it, not the notes themselves.
